gloss: so much, this much, like this

definitions.gloss: so much, this much, to this extent
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate the degree or extent of something near the speaker.

examples.japanese: こんなに⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I didn't think it would be this hot.
I didn't expect so many people to come.

examples.japanese: こんなに⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。

⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こんなに⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知|し}らなかった→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I didn't know Japanese was this difficult, so I struggled at first.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧こんなに⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: Since I had never seen such large buildings when I was a child, I was surprised when I first came to Tokyo.

notes:
こんなに expresses degree or extent, emphasizing that something is "this much" or "so much." It refers to something present or near the speaker, often conveying surprise or emphasis.

KO-SO-A-DO SERIES:
- こんなに: this much (near speaker)
- ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧: that much (near listener)
- ⟦あんなに→あんなに：01876_annani⟧: that much (far from both)
- ⟦どんなに→どんなに：03494_donnani⟧: how much (question/exclamation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- こんなに〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧: didn't think it would be this ~
- こんなに〜⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧: to be this ~ ! (surprise)
- こんなに⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: this many ~

USAGE:
Often used with adjectives or verbs to express surprise at the degree of something. Frequently appears with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧ to indicate something exceeded expectations.
